routes.title: Syntagma, Building An Agentic Curriculum Lifecycle Management System
routes.summary: A production-grade curriculum management platform for PES University: agentic refinement, 36-tool editor with reviewable drafts, git-like versioning, Jinja2-powered A4 PDFs, and a deliberately vanilla frontend.

routes.title: Project Halide, Building A Small-Model Diagnostic Workbench For Damaged Film
routes.summary: An open-weight film diagnostics workbench built around MiniCPM-V 4.6, Nemotron-Mini-4B, real negative failure cases, and a validator that became as important as the model.

routes.title: Teaching a 1.5B LLM to be a SOC Analyst (Without Burning Down the Network)
routes.summary: Fine-tuning a 1.5B LLM with GRPO to defend against realistic enterprise attack chains, and the unexpected lessons learned from reward hacking.

routes.title: Syntagma
routes.summary: Agentic curriculum lifecycle management system for PES University. Faculty submit raw course content, the agent refines it into structured records, the 36-tool editor lets admins propose reviewable edits, and every state is snapshotable with full diff history and official A4 PDF output.

routes.title: Project Halide
